short: Your Homeopathy offers wellness coaching and individualized homeopathy consultations in Monroe Township, NJ. In-person and virtual appointments and follow-up visits are available.
certs: DHM; AADP and National Center for Homeopathy affiliations.
training: Diploma in Homeopathy, British Institute of Homeopathy, 2006 (honors). Additional training in weight loss health coaching and mental health and wellness coaching.
pricing: Self-pay. Fees vary by age and visit type. Call 732-734-1973 for pricing.
long: Sheena Mansukhani, DHM, is a second-generation homeopathy practitioner and founder of Your Homeopathy. She offers wellness coaching and individual homeopathy consultations for families, with follow-up appointments available. Call 732-734-1973 for appointment options and pricing.
size: An independent practice serving families in Central New Jersey in person and virtually.
